_comment: Cleanup catalog. tier 1 = regenerable, low impact; tier 2 = regenerable but has a cost (re-download, shader recompile, lost diagnostics) - explain before offering; tier 3 = review-only, never deleted by Invoke-Clean without -AllowTier3 and a per-item user approval. method: files-older-than | file | tool-command | delivery-optimization | dism-component-cleanup | recycle-bin | report-only. Paths: forward slashes, %ENV% and %STEAM% tokens, '*' allowed in a single path segment.

targets.label: User temp folder
targets.note: Only files untouched for 3+ days; open/locked files are skipped.

targets.label: Application crash dumps
targets.note: Keep recent dumps if you are chasing a crash.

targets.label: Microsoft Edge cache (all profiles)
targets.note: Cache only. Cookies, logins, history, extensions and session data are never touched.

targets.label: VS Code caches
targets.note: Settings, extensions and workspace state are not touched.

targets.label: Steam logs and crash dumps
targets.note: Never touches steamapps, userdata, config or shader caches.

targets.label: Steam client web cache
targets.note: Store/community pages reload; you may need to sign in to web views again.

targets.label: Epic Games Launcher web cache and logs
GPU driver shader caches (AMD/NVIDIA/Intel/DirectX)
targets.note: Games will recompile shaders (stutter on first launches). Only worthwhile after a GPU driver change or suspected cache corruption. AMD Adrenalin > Settings > Graphics > Reset Shader Cache is the vendor-supported equivalent.

targets.label: AMD driver installer extraction folder (C:/AMD)
targets.note: Adrenalin extracts installers here and never cleans up. Safe once the current driver is installed and working; you lose the offline re-install copy.

targets.label: Delivery Optimization cache
targets.note: Uses the built-in Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache cmdlet. Delivery Optimization itself stays enabled (Store and Game Pass downloads use it).

targets.label: Windows component store (WinSxS) cleanup
targets.note: Runs DISM /StartComponentCleanup WITHOUT /ResetBase, so installed updates can still be uninstalled. Can take 5-30 minutes. Size is estimated by /AnalyzeComponentStore (Deep mode, admin).

targets.label: npm cache
targets.note: 'npm cache verify' garbage-collects unreferenced data only. A full 'npm cache clean --force' is tier 2 and must be requested explicitly.

targets.label: Yarn cache
targets.note: Offline installs will re-download.

targets.label: NuGet HTTP cache
targets.note: global-packages is left alone (rebuilds would re-download everything).

targets.label: Docker build cache
targets.note: Build cache only. Images, containers and volumes are never pruned by this skill. Requires Docker Desktop running.

targets.label: Kernel minidumps (BSOD evidence)
targets.note: Evidence for blue screens. Review crash history in the audit first.

targets.label: Full kernel memory dump (MEMORY.DMP)
targets.note: Evidence for the most recent blue screen.

targets.label: Live kernel reports (GPU TDR / hang evidence)
targets.note: Evidence for GPU driver timeouts. Keep while diagnosing game crashes.

targets.label: Recycle Bin
targets.note: Contains your deleted files. Only empty after you have confirmed nothing in it is needed.

targets.label: Previous Windows installation (Windows.old)
targets.note: Removing it ends the ability to roll back the last feature update. Use Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files > Previous Windows installation(s).

targets.label: Windows Update download cache
targets.note: Use Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files > Windows Update Cleanup. Never stop update services to delete these by hand.

targets.label: Hibernation file
targets.note: Report only. Disabling hibernation also disables Fast Startup; this skill never does it automatically.

targets.label: Page file
targets.note: Report only. Removing or shrinking the page file causes game and compiler crashes.
